{{Quote|You seen that new VT-16?''"<br />"''Yeah, some of the other guys were telling me about it. They say it's&hellip; it's quite a thing to see&hellip;|[[KE-829]] and [[Unidentified stormtrooper (BT-16)/Legends|his partner]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''BT-16 perimeter droid''', also known as the '''VT-16''', was a bulbous, spider-like [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]].

==Design==
The BT-16 perimeter droid was manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] resembled an [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] in design, with its long legs giving the unit stability while in motion<ref name="CFTD" /> and superior speed.<ref name="GG7" /> Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Arakyd redesigned the droid. The new design of the BT-16 was heavily borrowed from [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData's]] [[TS-Arach series Pest Control Droid]].<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

The BT-16 possessed heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating that gave it a degree of resistance to both physical and energy damage. The unit also mounted a [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]]. The droid's [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package was advanced, including a [[Carbanti United Electronics/Legends|Carbanti United Electronics]] [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]] and a [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[seismic sensor]]. The package was designed to sense the movement and presence of small animals.<ref name="CFTD" /> The sensors were located in the droid's abdomen.<ref name="GG7" />

==History==
The BT-16 was a droid well-known for its reliability. It was intended to protect [[Farm/Legends|farmland]] and related areas, such as [[Hydroponics/Legends|hydroponics gardens]], from being invaded and harmed by small creatures. The BT-16 soon became favored by [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] who needed to protect their land from "varmints."<ref name="CFTD" /> The [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]] modified the frames of BT-16s to serve as walkers for the monk's disembodied [[Brain/Legends|brains]]. These armatures were referred to as "[[B'omarr brain walker|brain walkers]]."<ref name="NEGTD" />

A used BT-16 perimeter security droid was utilized by the [[Katarn family]] of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], a [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. The droid, programmed to hunt vermin, possessed a faulty [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package which caused it to fire upon and kill [[Patricia Katarn]].<ref name="DFS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref>

Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Jarik]] at [[StarForge Station]] made a posting on [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]] offering [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] payment for military-grade [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile racks]]. He had a client who wanted to upgun their BT-16s to increase the defence around their manor house.<ref name="CFTD" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] purchased a large amount of the redesigned BT-16s for used aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. Before the droids could begin operating aboard the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], it was destroyed.<ref name="NEGTD" /> [[LBT-16]] was a BT-16 droid that was part of the droid lot available for purchase at [[Jawa Traders]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="GG7" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]'', the picture of the BT-16 is a mirrored version of the TS-Arach series Pest Control Droid image from the same guide.<ref name="CFTD" /> ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' established that Arakyd introduced a newer version of the BT-16 that heavily resembled the TS-Arach shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="NEGTD" />
